name: Anthropic AI for Science Program (API credits)

eligibility: Researchers at academic or non-profit research institutions working on high-impact scientific topics; Computer Science explicitly listed (biology/life sciences is a particular focus).

how_to_apply_tip: Frame the work as AI-for-science (e.g. AI applied to health, climate or materials) rather than pure ML; group collaborators under one organisation ID application. Unsuccessful applicants get no reply.
deadline_quote: We evaluate submissions on the first Monday of each month.
verdict_reason: Program targets researchers in academia with no nationality, age, gender or career-stage limit; as faculty at an academic institution in Pakistan (an Anthropic-supported country) the profile is covered.
eligibility_quote: The program serves "researchers in academia and nonprofit organizations working on scientific research topics we consider high priority"; FAQ: "researchers attached to research institutions." Supported-countries page: products and services are "available only in the countries and regions listed below" (list includes Pakistan).

name: Cohere Labs Catalyst Grants
amount: Cohere API credits (amount not published; more can be requested)

eligibility_quote: The grants "enable academic partners, civic and public impact organizations to access Cohere's models through the Cohere API." "Projects must be for public benefit or open science research."

name: SIGCHI Gary Marsden Travel Awards
amount: Depends on funds available and applications per cycle (complimentary registration codes + reimbursement of flights, lodging, meals, local transport, childcare; visa fees excluded)
duration: One-off per conference (physical travel support max once every 3 years)
eligibility: Students, early-career researchers (up to 5 years post-graduation), or those facing financial hardship / lacking institutional support; must be SIGCHI member when applying; attending SIGCHI-sponsored/in-cooperation conferences

That meets the 'up to 5 years post-graduation' early-career rule, and there is no nationality restriction. You must hold SIGCHI membership when you apply and attend a SIGCHI-sponsored or in-cooperation conference that starts more than one month after the deadline you choose.
eligibility_quote: Targets "early-career researchers (such as those who are ≤ 5 years post-graduation)" and those "experiencing financial hardship or lacking institutional support." "You must be a SIGCHI member at the time of application to be eligible." "For physical travel, you can only receive support once every three years."
